10.answer: Good morning, everyone. My name is Rehema. I am a Form One student from Morogoro. I enjoy reading stories and playing netball. English is my favourite subject because I like meeting people and sharing ideas. This term I hope to improve my writing. I look forward to learning with you. Thank you.
10.explanation: A suitable introduction greets the audience, gives personal details and interests in connected first-person sentences and ends politely. Use your own details.
